title: RemediationRecord
description: One finding's remediation outcome: a static, root-cause patch + security regression test (status=patched), prose guidance when the policy gate denies a patch (status=guidance_only), or a documented non-fix (status=cannot_fix). Generated statically — the patch is emitted as a unified diff by reading code; it is NEVER produced by executing the target.

security_test.description: a regression test that fails pre-fix, passes post-fix

needs_verification.description: true until --verify runs the target's tests in a sandbox
